name: Aqarios
description: Aqarios provides a cloud-based quantum computing platform called Luna for solving real-world optimization, simulation, and machine learning problems. Spun off from the QAR-Lab at LMU Munich, the company partners with IBM Quantum hardware and works with industrial clients including SAP, BASF, E.ON, and MTU Aero Engines.

products.name: Luna Platform
products.description: Quantum optimization software with IBM Quantum and NVIDIA CUDA-Q backend integrations

products.name: FlexQAOA
products.description: Constraint-aware quantum optimization algorithm embedding constraints directly into quantum circuits

highlights: Won Quantum Effects Award 2025 in Software & Algorithms category
Spin-off from QAR-Lab at LMU Munich

sources.title: Aqarios launches Luna, a quantum computing platform designed to simplify complex problem-solving for businesses
Scaling Quantum Simulation-Based Optimization: Demonstrating Efficient Power Grid Management with Deep QAOA Circuits

news.title: Aqarios Launches Luna Quantum Platform
news.excerpt: After a successful closed beta phase, Luna is now available to the public, providing businesses, developers, and researchers with access to a comprehensive suite of quantum tools. Luna democratizes quantum computing, making it accessible to users of all technical backgrounds.
